overview_description.description:
Quero Educação operates an online marketplace that connects students with schools in Brazil. Its marketplace allows students to find information about courses and schools where they want to study, compare college programs and options, get available tuition price and scholarship, and enroll and apply for graduation. 

Bernardo de Pádua, Lucas Gomes, and Thiago Brandão founded Quero Educação in 2010, with its headquarters in São José dos Campos in Brazil.
